system.description: Combatants who project force accurately across the battlefield — archers, snipers, gunslingers, siege specialists, and anyone who relies on distance, precision, and careful target selection.
system.benefit: Gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and two additional Ballistics Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Ballistics to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and four additional Ballistics Action Cards.

origin.name: Split Focus
origin.text: You may maintain two Locks at once. If you would establish a Lock on a third creature, choose which existing Lock ends.
